title: Weber Traveler Gas Barbecue
source_facts:
The Weber® Traveler Gas Barbecue is built for those who love great food outdoors—whether you’re camping, picnicking, or grilling on your patio. Designed with portability and performance in mind, this compact yet powerful barbecue features a single stainless steel burner, an integrated stand, and a large cooking area to prepare meals for up to four people.

 With its one-handed folding system and built-in wheels, the Weber Traveler moves easily from home to adventure. The porcelain-enamelled cast iron grates retain heat beautifully for perfect searing, while the efficient design ensures minimal gas consumption.

 
 Key Features 
 
 
 Large 2065 cm² cooking area (approx. 63 x 34 cm)

 
 
 Single high-performance stainless steel burner

 
 
 Porcelain-enamelled cast iron cooking grates

 
 
 Easy one-handed folding cart design

 
 
 Compact fold for car boot or tight storage

 
 
 Lid-mounted thermometer for heat monitoring

 
 
 Durable all-weather wheels for easy transport

 
 
 Side table with tool hooks

 
 
 Works with gas cartridges (adapter available for larger cylinders)

 
 
 Colour: Black

 
 
 
 Specifications 
 
 
 Cooking Area: Approx. 63 x 34 cm

 
 
 Fuel Type: Butane/Propane gas cartridge

title: Yoshino B4000 SST New Solid-State Portable Power Station
source_facts:
The Yoshino B4000 SST is a next-generation solid-state portable power station, offering 2,611Wh capacity and 4,000W continuous power (6,000W peak). Weighing just 53.6 lbs, this powerhouse delivers reliable, portable power for any adventure or backup need. Whether for outdoor camping, home backup, power tools, or off-grid use, the B4000 SST ensures you’re never without power.

 With its solid-state technology (SST), the B4000 SST is safer, more compact, and lighter than traditional lithium-ion batteries. It comes with two 15-watt wireless charging pads, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth app control, and a 10-port control panel, giving you multiple ways to power your devices simultaneously. The unit also supports Smart Link, allowing you to connect additional batteries and expand capacity for larger needs.

 Perfect for emergency backup, outdoor activities, and RV use, the B4000 SST offers a quiet, zero-emission solution with no harmful fumes. It can recharge quickly via AC power, solar power, or car charging.

 Key Features:

 ✅ Solid-State Technology (SST) – Compact, lighter, and safer than traditional lithium-ion batteries

Included is an attachment bar/hitch, a High-Performance (HP) PowerFlow Blower, a chute and a hopper assembly. The High-Performance PowerFlow Blower efficiently moves material up the chute and into the hopper/bagger. The chute provides a smooth flow of material and includes a convenient handle and a fill indicator to notify the operator when the bags are getting full. The hopper/bagger design provides efficient performance and easy-to-empty bags with a generous, 6.5-bushel capacity. This bagger is compatible with the Z515E and the Z530M with a 54 in. mowing deck. Weights are required for safe operation and are included.
